def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g)
    bg=g[0,0]
    # region/fill color = most common color != bg
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True)
    fill=[v for v,c in sorted(zip(vals,cnt),key=lambda t:-t[1]) if v!=bg][0]
    # hlines: rows without fill; vlines: cols without fill on band rows
    hls=[r for r in range(g.shape[0]) if fill not in g[r]]
    bands=[r for r in range(g.shape[0]) if fill in g[r]]
    vls=[c for c in range(g.shape[1]) if all(g[r,c]!=fill for r in bands)]
    hp=[tuple(g[r,c] for c in vls) for r in hls]
    # first marker hline/vline (pattern != all-bg)
    mh=next(i for i,p in enumerate(hp) if any(v!=bg for v in p))
    mv=next(j for j in range(len(vls)) if any(hp[i][j]!=bg for i in range(len(hls))))
    # span of marker hlines/vlines
    mh_last=max(i for i,p in enumerate(hp) if any(v!=bg for v in p))
    mv_last=max(j for j in range(len(vls)) if any(hp[i][j]!=bg for i in range(len(hls))))
    R=mh_last-mh; C=mv_last-mv
    out=np.full((R,C),fill)
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            a,b=hp[mh+i][mv+j],hp[mh+i][mv+j+1]
            c_,d=hp[mh+i+1][mv+j],hp[mh+i+1][mv+j+1]
            if a==b==c_==d and a!=bg: out[i,j]=a
    return out.tolist()
